headline: Indian Rupee Strengthens Below 93 Per Dollar on $12 Billion Monthly Inflows
summary: The Indian rupee strengthened past 93 against the US dollar for the first time since April, supported by over $12 billion in foreign portfolio equity and bond inflows during November.
why: The Indian rupee's exchange rate reflects net capital flows and economic sentiment toward India's financial markets.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Over $12 billion in monthly foreign investment inflows drove local currency appreciation.
